2607.06796.title: Enhancing deep learning models for time series classification via knowledge distillation
2607.06796.paper_summary: Deep learning has achieved remarkable success in various domains including time series analysis, computer vision and natural language processing. However, high computational and memory demands of state-of-the-art architectures pose challenges for deployment in resource-limited environments. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller, more efficient student model while maintaining competitive performance. In this work, we investigate the effectiveness of KD for Time Series Classification (TSC) across three architectures: the classical Fully Convolutional Network (FCN), the convolutional Inception model and the transformer-based ConvTran model. We evaluate our approach on UCR Archive, the largest benchmark repository of time series datasets, by modifying architectural components such as convolutional filters, Inception modules and attention heads across the three architectures. Our results consistently show that KD most effectively benefits student models of intermediate complexity across all three architectures, with the distilled FCN student reducing parameters by a factor of 38, the distilled Inception student achieving nearly the same performance as the teacher with 42% fewer parameters and the distilled ConvTran student with 2 attention heads showing the most significant improvement through distillation. To encourage further research and reproducibility, we provide our implementation at https://github.com/MSD-IRIMAS/KD-4-TSC.
2607.06796.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習在各個領域取得了顯著的成功，包括時間序列分析、計算機視覺和自然語言處理。<lb/>然而，最先進架構的高計算和記憶體需求對於在資源有限的環境中部署提出了挑戰。<lb/>知識蒸餾（KD）通過將知識從大型教師模型轉移到較小、更高效的學生模型來解決這一問題，同時保持競爭力的性能。<lb/>在本研究中，我們探討了KD在時間序列分類（TSC）中的有效性，涵蓋三種架構：經典的全卷積網絡（FCN）、卷積的Inception模型和基於Transformer的ConvTran模型。<lb/>我們在UCR Archive上評估我們的方法，這是最大的時間序列數據集基準庫，通過修改三種架構中的建築組件，如卷積濾波器、Inception模塊和注意力頭。<lb/>我們的結果一致顯示，KD在所有三種架構中對中等複雜度的學生模型最有效，蒸餾的FCN學生將參數減少了38倍，蒸餾的Inception學生在參數減少42%的情況下達到了幾乎與教師相同的性能，而蒸餾的ConvTran學生則在只有2個注意力頭的情況下顯示出通過蒸餾獲得的最顯著改進。<lb/>為了鼓勵進一步的研究和可重現性，我們在https://github.com/MSD-IRIMAS/KD-4-TSC提供了我們的實現。
